senses.sense_definition: The decorative molding or frame surrounding a doorway, window, or other rectangular opening.

examples.text: The carpenter carefully attached the wooden <w>architrave</w> around the newly installed doorway.
Intricate carvings decorated the stone <w>architrave</w> framing each grand window of the manor.

senses.sense_definition: The lowest section of an entablature in classical architecture that rests directly on the capitals of the columns; an epistyle.

examples.text: In classical temples, the massive <w>architrave</w> spans the space between the supporting columns.
The frieze sits immediately above the stone <w>architrave</w> across the front of the ancient monument.
